alpha_hypothesis.playbook_alignment: Tests a deterministic state-surface quality field rather than LLM soft-ranking or noisy ticker-pool expansion.

backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; accepted exp-20260519-027 baseline artifact plus default-off state-surface paper overlay replay.

gate1.baseline_note: Uses accepted exp-20260519-027 sleeve-capacity notional as Gate 1 baseline.

gate3.hard_rule: No filter, ranking, or candidate gate changed; only paper notional changes for already-selected trades.

history_check.anti_repeat: Not a ret5/ret20/ret60 threshold, near-high, volume-threshold, sector-cohesion, score-gap, candidate-pool, SEC text, or LLM soft-ranking retry.
history_check.exp-20260519-027: Accepted sleeve-capacity notional; this experiment freezes it and tests a distinct selected-trade queue-lag quality field.
history_check.nearby_rejections: Avoids global capacity retunes, broad SEC tone/text scalars, rank4 no-sample retries, and LLM soft-ranking.

hypothesis: Selected state-surface paper candidates whose raw rank lags their queue position are replacement-value winners created by core exclusions/slot ordering, so they deserve a bounded notional support scalar.
interpretation: Queue-lag support improved the default-off state-surface paper overlay without changing core trades, filters, ranking, or live/default orders.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking data remains sparse/PIT-limited; this tests a replayable rank/queue displacement field.

next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off paper metadata; keep forward tail/concentration monitoring before any live adapter work.

parameters.profile_priority: applies after the accepted sleeve-capacity notional stack and before recent-repeat paper metadata

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: selected state-surface candidates with raw rank worse than queue rank may have replacement-value alpha from core exclusions/queue displacement.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: No prior accepted experiment tested rank > queue_rank support after exp-20260519-027. Recent LLM/pool lanes are data-limited and global capacity was just accepted.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, zero EV-regressed windows, adjusted trades >=8 across >=2 windows, max DD drift <=0.5pp, single-ticker positive share <=50%.
